author: alisongardner
quote:
GTA 6: SIMP CITY

Made by man-hating, self-righteous writers, this is the most beautiful piece of **** I’ve ever played. I waited 13 years for this game, and it will probably take me three days to forget about it and move on. The writers clearly didn’t hesitate to pour their own lives and experiences into the game, as usually happens with these egotistical virtue signalers. The game’s purpose isn’t to let you have fun. It’s to teach you what the ideal man supposedly looks like according to these lunatics. This game is too big to fail, and unfortunately, Rockstar will wipe their asses with our reviews. Rockstar you betrayed the people who made you what you are. I wish I could get a refund and buy something else. And by the way: 30 frames per second? My ass. It averages closer to 20, making you dizzy and giving you the feeling that you’re walking underwater. The programmers were probably too focused on making sure nobody was misgendered, everyone used the correct pronouns, and the players felt as cucked as possible. GTA 6: SIMP CITY.
